card.name: Inside carboxymaltose and hydroxymethyl names
card.fires_on: The piece 'ym' in the middle of drug and chemical names, mainly after 'carbox' or 'hydrox' (carboxymethylcellulose, ferric carboxymaltose, 5-hydroxymethyl tolterodine). Also similar mid-name pieces like 'lu' in trifluoperazine.

modes.label: carbox-ym-
modes.description: The 'ym' piece after 'carbox' in carboxymethylcellulose or ferric carboxymaltose.

modes.label: hydrox-ym-
modes.description: The 'ym' piece after 'hydrox' in metabolite names such as hydroxymethyl tolterodine or hydroxymidazolam.
